title: Quantum algebra thoughts on the Riemann hypothesis
description:
Preprint (22 pages, PDF and LaTeX source), together with the 5 Python programs used for its computations.

We interpret the normalized Li coefficients as averages of squared characters on rotation groups. On the free orthogonal quantum group O₂⁺, the Riemann hypothesis is equivalent to the existence of a central tracial state with these moments. We also discuss the quantum permutation group S₄⁺, recover von Koch’s criterion from the norms of gaps below Jones index 4, and relate Montgomery’s pair correlation conjecture to the character polynomial of a quantum unitary group.
